title: Intrinsic fibre, normalized lattice and chart data
statement: For a prime l, finite extension E of Q_l, and a Noetherian finite-dimensional scheme X with l invertible [lem-per-continuous-rational-derived-realization], define the rational heart and its H^0 realization. Define the intrinsic fibre by balanced module inverse image to Spec(kappa), final-object evaluation and scalar restriction along constant E-sections. Define Lattice with an actual locally free integral module, its finite-free normalized etale tower, specified inverse-limit reduction cone, cokernel quotients and scalar compatibility. Define Chart, Adapted, Represents, Point and Assertions with exactly their existing meanings. LocalLattices retains only local chart existence, intrinsic normalization and fractional naturality. GeometricPoint bundles an algebraically closed field and a map from its spectrum. These are types and constructions, asserting no existence.
